picks.why: Micron guided to a record $61.5B quarter with 379% revenue growth and 81% operating margin, yet trades at 4.4x forward earnings and 27% below its high. That is the cheapest earnings in the universe, with the cycle-peak risk priced in.
picks.risk: Memory prices turn down and peak margins collapse, which is why a 4x P/E can be a trap.
